item.title: iPhone 国行 AI 官宣，11 月 4 日开放测试
item.guid: iPhone-国行-AI-官宣，11-月-4-日开放测试
item.description:
Apple announced that the first batch of Apple Intelligence features will be available for testing in China with the iOS developer Beta on November 4, and officially launched with iOS 27.3 in December. Apple has partnered with Alibaba to integrate Tongyi Qianwen into some experiences in Siri, writing tools, and visual intelligence, supporting text and image understanding. 苹果宣布，首批 Apple 智能功能将于 11 月 4 日随 iOS 开发者 Beta 版在中国开放测试，并于 12 月随 iOS 27.3 正式推出。苹果与阿里巴巴合作，在 Siri、写作工具和视觉智能的部分体验中接入千问，支持文本与图像理解。

The first batch of features includes real-time translation in Messages, FaceTime, and Phone calls; rewriting, proofreading, and summarization in writing tools; photo erasure, natural language search, and memory movie creation; as well as Smart Emoji, notification summaries, and priority mail. After logging into a Tongyi Qianwen account or using "Sign in with Apple," users can invoke Tongyi Qianwen within the system; the "Create" function in writing tools can also generate content with the help of Tongyi Qianwen. 首批功能包括信息、FaceTime 和电话中的实时翻译，写作工具的改写、校对与摘要，照片消除、自然语言搜索及回忆影片创建，以及智绘表情、通知摘要和优先邮件等。用户登录千问账户或使用「通过 Apple 登录」后，可在系统内调用千问；写作工具中的「创作」功能也可借助千问生成内容。

Supported devices include iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16 and later models, iPhone Duo, and iPhone Air. This update does not include Siri AI and other next-generation Apple Intelligence features announced by Apple at WWDC 2026; other platforms will require necessary approvals before launch. 支持设备包括 iPhone 15 Pro、iPhone 15 Pro Max、iPhone 16 及后续机型、iPhone Duo 和 iPhone Air。此次更新不包含 Siri AI 及苹果在 WWDC 2026 上公布的其他下一代 Apple 智能功能，其他平台需获得必要审批后推出。

Face-to-face conversation translation requires the use of AirPods 5, AirPods 4 Active Noise Cancellation models, AirPods Pro 2 and later models, or AirPods Max 2 with the latest firmware installed. 面对面对话翻译需配合安装最新固件的 AirPods 5、AirPods 4 主动降噪款、AirPods Pro 2 及后续机型，或 AirPods Max 2 使用。

🔗 Related reading: Breaking! iPhone's domestic AI is really here, Tongyi Qianwen becomes Siri's new partner 🔗 相关阅读： 突发！iPhone 国行 AI 真的来了，千问成为 Siri 新搭档

item.title: DeepSeek 千亿融资曝光，腾讯、宁德时代、长鑫等参投
item.guid: DeepSeek-千亿融资曝光，腾讯、宁德时代、长鑫等参投
item.description:
According to The Information, DeepSeek completed its second round of financing this month, raising approximately 105.5 billion RMB (about 15.8 billion USD) from nearly 30 investors, with a post-money valuation of 615.5 billion RMB. 据 The Information 报道，DeepSeek 本月完成了约 1055 亿元人民币（约 158 亿美元）的第二轮融资，来自近 30 家投资者，投后估值为 6155 亿元人民币。

The report states that Tencent and CATL remain DeepSeek's top two investors. New investors in this round include Changxin Memory Technologies and its chairman Zhu Yiming, as well as SMIC. Vivo, Meituan, Midea, Luxshare Precision, Geely, Trip.com, and Xiaohongshu also participated, with individual investments ranging from 1 billion to 3 billion RMB. 报道称，腾讯和宁德时代仍是 DeepSeek 的前两大投资者。本轮新加入的投资方包括长鑫存储及其董事长朱一明，以及中芯国际。vivo、美团、美的、立讯精密、吉利、携程和小红书也参与其中，单家出资规模在 10 亿至 30 亿元人民币之间。

State-owned telecom operators China Mobile and China Telecom, investment banks CICC and CITIC Securities, and insurance company China Life, invested between 2 billion and 8 billion RMB. The National Artificial Intelligence Industry Development Fund invested another 1 billion RMB, the same as in the first round, and it is a direct investment in DeepSeek. 国有电信运营商中国移动、中国电信，投行中金公司、中信证券，以及保险公司中国人寿，出资规模在 20 亿至 80 亿元人民币之间。国家人工智能产业发展基金再次出资 10 亿元人民币，与首轮相同，且是直接投资 DeepSeek。

DeepSeek has raised a total of 136.5 billion RMB in approximately 6 months, with Liang Wenfeng additionally investing 2 billion RMB into the company. DeepSeek 在约 6 个月内累计融资 1365 亿元人民币，梁文锋另外向公司投入 20 亿元人民币。

item.title: 特斯拉推出 5 年零息方案，Model 3 / Y 首付 3.99 万元起
item.guid: 特斯拉推出-5-年零息方案，Model-3-/-Y-首付-3.99-万元起
item.description:
Tesla has launched a new round of 5-year zero-interest car financing plans in China, valid from October 30 to November 30 (inclusive). According to Jiemian News, the rear-wheel drive, long-range rear-wheel drive, and long-range all-wheel drive versions of Model 3 and Model Y are eligible, with down payments starting from 39,900 yuan. 特斯拉在中国推出新一轮 5 年零息购车金融方案，活动时间为 10 月 30 日至 11 月 30 日（含）。据界面新闻，Model 3 和 Model Y 的后轮驱动版、长续航后轮驱动版及长续航全轮驱动版可参加，首付均为 3.99 万元起。

This round's plan adopts a "down payment + monthly payment + final balloon payment" structure. After a 10,000 yuan reduction on the Model 3's final payment, the maximum monthly payment for five years is approximately 2,429 yuan; after a 4,000 yuan reduction on the Model Y's final payment, the maximum monthly payment for five years is approximately 2,995 yuan. Both models have an additional 39,900 yuan final payment at the end of the installment period. 本轮方案采用「首付 + 月付 + 期末尾款」的结构。Model 3 尾款立减 1 万元后，五年月供最高约 2429 元；Model Y 尾款立减 4000 元后，五年月供最高约 2995 元。两者在分期结束时均另有 3.99 万元尾款。

The Model Y L has a down payment starting from 59,900 yuan, with a maximum monthly payment of approximately 3,920 yuan for five years, and a final balloon payment of 39,900 yuan. Tesla China's Model 3 ordering page also lists limited-time 5-year zero-interest and specified version final payment reduction benefits. Model Y L 首付为 5.99 万元起，五年月供最高约 3920 元，期末尾款同为 3.99 万元。特斯拉中国 Model 3 订购页也列出了限时 5 年零息和指定版本尾款立减权益。

item.title: 于东来建议支持「消费入座」，餐厅可拒绝外带食物就餐
item.guid: 于东来建议支持「消费入座」，餐厅可拒绝外带食物就餐
item.description:
Yu Donglai, founder of Pang Donglai, issued a statement suggesting institutional support for "seated consumption" to protect the interests of merchants and in-store customers, and supporting restaurants in refusing customers who bring outside food. 胖东来创始人于东来发文，建议以制度支持「消费入座」，保护商家及在店顾客的利益，并支持餐厅拒绝顾客携带外带食物就餐。

According to Jiemian News, he linked this suggestion with fostering business order, commercial environment, and consumption habits, while also mentioning personal character cultivation. 据界面新闻报道，他将这项建议与培养商业秩序、商业环境及消费习惯联系在一起，同时提到个人的品格修养。

He wrote: "Cultivate a civilized and beautiful business order and commercial environment, good consumption habits, and promote personal character cultivation!" The statement places the issues of restaurant seating and outside food in the discussion of the interests of both merchants and in-store customers. 他写道：「培养文明美好的商业秩序和商业环境、良好的消费习惯和推动个人的品格修养！」发文将餐厅入座及外带食物问题，放在商家、在店消费顾客双方利益的讨论中。

item.title: 开发者在 Surface Duo 2 上启动 iOS 27 iPhone Duo 版本
item.guid: 开发者在-Surface-Duo-2-上启动-iOS-27-iPhone-Duo-版本
item.description:
Developer SmuOS showcased the latest progress in running iOS 27 on the Microsoft Surface Duo 2. This time, the iPhone Duo version is used, and the system desktop can recognize the inner and outer screen layouts of the folding device. 开发者 SmuOS 展示了在微软 Surface Duo 2 上运行 iOS 27 的最新进展。这次使用的是 iPhone Duo 版本，系统桌面可以识别折叠设备的内外屏布局。

According to his original post, iOS 27 distinguishes between the outer screen and the unfolded state through display types 31 and 32. SpringBoard will only enable the Duo-exclusive desktop layout after detecting these two types. The developer also showed a screen with excessive interface scaling, indicating that adaptation is still being adjusted. 据其原帖，iOS 27 通过显示类型 31 与 32 区分外屏和展开状态。SpringBoard 检测到这两种类型后，才会启用 Duo 专属桌面布局。开发者还展示了界面缩放过大的画面，显示适配仍在调整。

item.title: REDMI 回应 K100 选用旧旗舰芯：性能表现胜任游戏
item.guid: REDMI-回应-K100-选用旧旗舰芯：性能表现胜任游戏
item.description:
REDMI released a Q&A session for K100, REDMI Book 2027, and REDMI Clip Neo, addressing questions from netizens about the new products' chip, heat dissipation, and microphone design. REDMI 发布 K100、REDMI Book 2027 与 REDMI Clip Neo 的答网友问，回应新产品的芯片、散热及麦克风设计。

  • K100: The official statement admits that Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition is not the latest platform, emphasizing daily stability and gaming performance under Pengpai OS 4, and supporting frame interpolation for some games with the D2 discrete graphics card. K100：官方承认骁龙 8 至尊版并非当代最新平台，强调澎湃 OS 4 下的日常稳定性及游戏表现，并以 D2 独显支持部分游戏插帧。
  • REDMI Book 2027: Features an integrated dual-fan design to distribute heat dissipation needs. Official figures state daily office noise is within 25dBA, and full load is 38dBA; a single M.2 SSD slot is compatible with 2242 and 2280 specifications, allowing for replacement and upgrade. REDMI Book 2027：采用一体双风扇分摊散热需求。官方给出的日常办公噪声为 25dBA 以内，满载为 38dBA；单个 M.2 硬盘槽兼容 2242 与 2280 规格，可更换升级。
  • REDMI Clip Neo: Dual MIC refers to two microphones per earbud, totaling four for both ears, working with an AI call noise reduction algorithm to process wind noise and ambient sound. REDMI Clip Neo：双 MIC 指单耳两枚，双耳合计四枚，配合 AI 通话降噪算法处理风噪及环境声。

item.title: 张雪称拉黑母亲微信，反对机构把家人当作流量入口
item.guid: 张雪称拉黑母亲微信，反对机构把家人当作流量入口
item.description:
Zhang Xue, founder of Zhang Xue Motorcycle, posted a video stating that he has blocked his mother's WeChat. He said that after he won the championship, his mother frequently accepted filming and interviews, and he had repeatedly asked her to stop. 张雪机车创始人张雪发布视频称，自己已拉黑母亲的微信。他表示，夺冠后母亲频繁接受拍摄和采访，自己曾多次要求停止。

Zhang Xue opposes institutions and individuals using family members as traffic entry points, stating: "I despise any institution or person who wants to use my mother as a traffic entry point." 张雪反对机构及个人把家人当作流量入口，并表示：「所有想以我妈为流量入口的机构或者人，我都鄙视你。」

Zhang Xue also wrote in the video caption: "Anyone or anything that drains me, I will cut off without hesitation, no matter who you are." 张雪在视频文案中还写道：「所有消耗我的人或事，我会毫不犹豫地砍掉，不管你是谁。」

item.title: OpenAI 重构模型规范，将「忠于人类意图」列为首项准则
item.guid: OpenAI-重构模型规范，将「忠于人类意图」列为首项准则
item.description:
Recently, OpenAI updated its Model Spec, reorganizing the principles of model behavior around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm reduction, honesty and transparency, safeguarding human autonomy, and cautious care. The specification is aimed at GPT models powering products like ChatGPT and APIs, publicly outlining how the company intends to shape model behavior. 近日，OpenAI 更新 Model Spec，以五项价值重新组织模型行为原则：忠于人类意图、减少伤害、诚实透明、保障人的自主选择，以及审慎关怀。规范面向驱动 ChatGPT 和 API 等产品的 GPT 模型，公开说明公司希望如何塑造模型行为。

The new version places what users and developers want to achieve at its core, while retaining instruction hierarchies and safety boundaries. For tasks where the goal is unclear, the model should understand intent based on context; for facts, evidence, uncertainties, capabilities, and actual actions taken, it should provide truthful explanations, allowing people to evaluate its work. 新版把用户和开发者想完成什么放在核心位置，同时保留指令层级与安全边界。对于目标尚不明确的任务，模型应结合上下文理解意图；对事实、证据、不确定性、能力和实际采取的行动，则应如实说明，让人能够评估其工作。

The specification also specifically discusses the tension between immediate instructions and long-term goals: models can prompt overlooked consequences and help users think, but they cannot treat their predictions of choices users will make in the future as decisions users have already made. OpenAI states that online models have not yet fully met the specification requirements, and the company will continue to adjust training and systems. 规范还专门讨论了即时指令与长期目标之间的张力：模型可以提示被忽略的后果、帮助用户思考，但不能把自己预测用户将来会作出的选择，视为用户已经作出的决定。OpenAI 表示，线上模型尚未完全达到规范要求，公司将继续调整训练与系统。

item.title: 米哈游《星布谷地》定档 12 月 4 日公测
item.guid: 米哈游《星布谷地》定档-12-月-4-日公测
item.description:
miHoYo's life simulation game "Starfall Valley" announced that its open beta will begin on December 4th, with an official promotional video released simultaneously. A special preview program for the open beta will be held on November 1st at 19:00. 米哈游旗下生活模拟游戏《星布谷地》宣布，公测将于 12 月 4 日开启，官方同步发布定档宣传片，11 月 1 日 19:00 将举办公测前瞻特别节目。

Players take on the role of "Star Planters" in the game, managing their own planet: transforming terrain, planning areas, collecting resources, and crafting furniture; they can also pick, adventure, and build houses with animal neighbors. When exploring outwards, players can sail to star islands with different topographies and ecosystems, search for resources, and meet other players in the Starry Sky Market. 玩家在游戏中扮演「种星人」，经营一颗自己的星球：改造地形、规划区域，采集资源并制作家具；也可以与动物邻居一起采摘、冒险和建房。向外探索时，玩家可驾船前往不同地貌和生态的星屿，寻找资源，并在星空街市与其他玩家相遇。

According to Bahamut GNN, the game will open for pre-download on December 1st, available on PC, iOS, and Android. Official website pre-registration is now open, and completing registration will grant a "Starry Sky Light Stick." Global pre-registration milestones will also unlock rewards such as the "Little Star Seed" outfit. 据巴哈姆特 GNN 报道，游戏将于 12 月 1 日开放预下载，登陆 PC、iOS 和 Android。官网已开放预约，完成预约可获得「星空贴贴手灯」，全球预约里程碑还将解锁「小星苗」套装等奖励。

item.title: 大众 CFO：电动车热销也带来利润压力，须加快降本
item.guid: 大众-CFO：电动车热销也带来利润压力，须加快降本
item.description:
Arno Antlitz, CFO and COO of Volkswagen Group, stated in the Q3 earnings announcement that electric vehicle orders account for 40% in Europe, but EV profits are currently lower than those of internal combustion engine vehicles, and sales growth also brings additional pressure on profitability. 大众集团 CFO 兼 COO Arno Antlitz 在前三季度业绩声明中表示，电动车在欧洲的订单占比达到 40%，但现阶段电动车利润低于燃油车，销量增长也给盈利带来额外压力。

He also mentioned US tariffs, the shrinking Chinese market, and intensified competition in Europe. Volkswagen's operating sales return rate after excluding special items for the first three quarters was 3.8%, a level he believes is insufficient to support large-scale future investments. 他同时提到美国关税、中国市场收缩和欧洲竞争加剧。大众前三季度剔除特殊项目后的营业销售回报率为 3.8%，他认为这一水平不足以支撑未来的大规模投入。

Antlitz's proposed countermeasures include streamlining vehicle models, simplifying organization, reducing vehicle and management costs, improving factory efficiency, and accelerating technology development. He demanded that these measures be implemented quickly and consistently. Antlitz 提出的应对措施包括精简车型、简化组织、降低车辆及管理成本、提高工厂效率，并加快技术开发。他要求迅速、一致地执行这些措施。

item.title: OPPO 调整高管分工：李炳忠统管海外，尹文广负责全系手机
item.guid: OPPO-调整高管分工：李炳忠统管海外，尹文广负责全系手机
item.description:
According to Jiemian News on October 30, OPPO announced executive appointments and division of labor adjustments: Senior Vice President Li Bingzhong will be fully responsible for overseas business, accountable for the operating results of OPPO and its sub-series in overseas markets; Vice President Yin Wenguang will be responsible for all mobile phone product series, reporting to Chief Product Officer Liu Zuohu. 据界面新闻 10 月 30 日报道，OPPO 发布高管任命与分工调整通知：高级副总裁李炳忠全面负责海外业务，对 OPPO 及子系列在海外市场的经营结果负责；副总裁尹文广负责所有手机产品系列，向首席产品官刘作虎汇报。

Li Bingzhong is one of OPPO's early pioneers in overseas expansion, having participated in front-line markets, localized operations, and global brand business; Yin Wenguang has long been responsible for product planning. Liu Zuohu coordinates the synergistic experience of mobile phones and ecosystem products, technological innovation, and the development of new categories. 李炳忠是 OPPO 早期出海开拓者之一，曾参与一线市场、本土化运营和全球品牌业务；尹文广长期负责产品规划。刘作虎则统筹手机与生态产品的协同体验、技术创新及新品类开拓。

item.title: 亚马逊 CEO：2027 年资本开支将明显高于今年的 2200 亿美元
item.guid: 亚马逊-CEO：2027-年资本开支将明显高于今年的-2200-亿美元
item.description:
Amazon CEO Andy Jassy stated on the Q3 earnings call that the company still plans to invest $220 billion in capital expenditures in 2026, with spending in 2027 to be 'significantly more'. 亚马逊 CEO Andy Jassy 在第三季度财报电话会上表示，公司仍计划在 2026 年投入 2200 亿美元资本开支，2027 年的支出将「明显更多」。

According to the original Business Insider report, Amazon's Q3 cash capital expenditure was $75.9 billion, primarily invested in AWS and AI infrastructure; free cash flow over the past 12 months was negative $42.4 billion. 据 Business Insider 原始报道，亚马逊第三季度现金资本开支为 759 亿美元，主要投向 AWS 与 AI 基础设施；过去 12 个月自由现金流为负 424 亿美元。

Jassy stated that large customers pre-book hundreds of megawatts, or even gigawatts, of computing capacity, allowing the company to see demand for 2027, 2028, and even parts of 2029. He expects AWS's revenue growth rate to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028. Jassy 表示，大型客户会提前预订数百兆瓦、甚至吉瓦级的算力容量，公司因此能看到 2027 年、2028 年乃至部分 2029 年的需求。他预计 AWS 在 2027 年和 2028 年的收入增速均可超过 40%。

item.title: Reddit CEO：Google AI Mode 没给网站带来流量
item.guid: Reddit-CEO：Google-AI-Mode-没给网站带来流量
item.description:
Reddit CEO Steve Huffman stated on the Q3 earnings call that Google's AI Mode has not brought traffic to Reddit; to his knowledge, other websites have not benefited from it either. Reddit CEO Steve Huffman 在第三季度财报电话会上表示，Google 的 AI Mode 没有给 Reddit 带来流量；据他所知，其他网站也没有从中受益。

According to the original report by The Verge, Reddit's average weekly referral traffic from Google decreased by over 1 million in October. Huffman believes that AI Overview and AI Mode push external links further down, and the ranking of machine-translated content in some non-U.S. markets has also declined. 据 The Verge 原始报道，Reddit 在 10 月来自 Google 的平均每周引荐流量减少超过 100 万。Huffman 认为，AI Overview 和 AI Mode 将外部链接推到更靠下的位置，部分美国以外市场的机器翻译内容排名也有所下降。

He also stated that user search demand for Reddit still exists, and Google's crawling activity on Reddit has not seen a corresponding decline. 他同时表示，用户对 Reddit 的搜索需求仍然存在，Google 抓取 Reddit 的活动没有出现相应下降。

item.title: 奇瑞前三季度营收 2412.34 亿元，归母净利润下滑
item.guid: 奇瑞前三季度营收-2412.34-亿元，归母净利润下滑
item.description:
Chery Automobile announced its unaudited results as of the end of September, with revenue for the first three quarters at 241.234 billion yuan, compared to 214.833 billion yuan in the same period last year; net profit attributable to the parent company was 13.963 billion yuan, compared to 14.365 billion yuan in the same period last year. 奇瑞汽车公布截至 9 月底的未经审计业绩，前三季度收入为 2412.34 亿元，上年同期为 2148.33 亿元；归母净利润为 139.63 亿元，上年同期为 143.65 亿元。

During the period, gross profit increased from 29.464 billion yuan to 39.004 billion yuan. R&D expenses increased from 7.878 billion yuan to 11.046 billion yuan, and sales and administrative expenses also increased. 期内毛利润由 294.64 亿元增至 390.04 亿元。研发费用由 78.78 亿元增至 110.46 亿元，销售与行政费用也有所增加。

Exchange rate changes affected other income and expenses: a net exchange loss of 3.171 billion yuan was recorded in the current period, compared to a net exchange gain of 2.974 billion yuan in the same period last year. 汇率变化影响了其他收支：本期录得汇兑净损失 31.71 亿元，上年同期则有汇兑净收益 29.74 亿元。

item.title: 传音第三季度营收下降 27.45%，前三季度归母净利润仍增长
item.guid: 传音第三季度营收下降-27.45%，前三季度归母净利润仍增长
item.description:
Transsion Holdings disclosed its Q3 report: Q3 operating revenue was 14.849 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 27.45%; net profit attributable to the parent company was 857 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 8.40%; non-recurring net profit attributable to the parent company was 436 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 47.72%. 传音控股披露第三季度报告：第三季度营业收入为 148.49 亿元，同比下降 27.45%；归母净利润为 8.57 亿元，同比下降 8.40%；扣非归母净利润为 4.36 亿元，同比下降 47.72%。

Extended to the first three quarters, revenue was 50.280 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 1.49%; net profit attributable to the parent company was 2.630 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 22.44%. In its report, the company linked the decline in non-recurring profit in Q3 to rising supply chain costs and reduced revenue due to changes in market capacity. 拉长至前三季度，收入为 502.80 亿元，同比增长 1.49%；归母净利润为 26.30 亿元，同比增长 22.44%。公司在报告中将第三季度扣非利润下降与供应链成本上升、市场容量变化带来的收入减少联系起来。

Net cash outflow from operating activities in the first three quarters was 9.873 billion yuan. The company stated that rising storage prices, increased inventory, and growth in procurement payments affected cash flow. 前三季度经营活动现金流净流出 98.73 亿元。公司称，存储价格上升、备货增加及采购支付增长影响了现金流。

item.title: 火山引擎将商业化列为首要目标，MaaS 上半年收入达 48 亿元
item.guid: 火山引擎将商业化列为首要目标，MaaS-上半年收入达-48-亿元
item.description:
According to a report by LatePost on October 30, Volcano Engine's MaaS (Model as a Service) business generated 4.8 billion yuan in revenue in the first half of the year, with a gross profit margin exceeding 55%, making it ByteDance's largest AI business by revenue scale. 据《晚点 LatePost》10 月 30 日报道，火山引擎的 MaaS（模型即服务）业务上半年收入达到 48 亿元，毛利率超过 55%，是字节跳动当前收入规模最大的 AI 业务。

The report cited sources saying that Volcano Engine began prioritizing commercialization as its most important business metric in the middle of the year, and raised its original annual revenue target of 15 billion yuan. Previously, the business focused more on token call volume; enterprises pay based on usage, and billing methods vary for different modal models, so call volume and revenue do not always grow synchronously. 报道援引知情人士称，火山引擎从年中开始把商业化定为最重要的业务指标，并上调原定 150 亿元的年度收入目标。此前，业务更重视 Token 调用量；企业按使用量付费，而不同模态的模型计费方式各异，调用量与收入并不总是同步增长。

Volcano Engine provides self-developed models such as Seed and Seedance, and also integrates third-party models like DeepSeek and Zhipu. The report states that these model inference services currently all have positive gross margins; Doubao Work also plans to integrate more third-party models for enterprise customers, adopting a combination of subscription fees and pay-per-use. 火山引擎既提供 Seed、Seedance 等自研模型，也接入 DeepSeek、智谱等第三方模型。报道称，目前这些模型推理服务均有正毛利；豆包工作还计划面向企业客户接入更多第三方模型，采用订阅费与按量付费结合的方式。

item.title: 长鑫第三季度营收突破千亿元，归母净利润环比增长 3.01%
item.guid: 长鑫第三季度营收突破千亿元，归母净利润环比增长-3.01%
item.description:
Changxin Technology disclosed its Q3 report on October 30: Q3 operating revenue was 118.714 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 613.18% and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 19.30%; net profit attributable to the parent company was 54.435 billion yuan, turning losses into profits year-on-year and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 3.01%. The quarter-on-quarter increase in net profit attributable to the parent company was lower than that of revenue. 长鑫科技 10 月 30 日披露三季报：第三季度营业收入为 1187.14 亿元，同比增长 613.18%、环比增长 19.30%；归母净利润为 544.35 亿元，同比扭亏、环比增长 3.01%。归母净利润的环比增幅低于营收。

The company stated that the growth in global computing power demand and the capacity allocation by major manufacturers led to a shortage of DRAM, coupled with its own capacity building and product structure adjustment, driving up product sales and prices. The gross profit margin in Q3 was 89.53%, an increase of 1.94 percentage points from the previous quarter. 公司称，全球算力需求增长、主要厂商产能调配推动 DRAM 供不应求，加上自身产能建设与产品结构调整，带动产品销量和价格上涨。第三季度毛利率为 89.53%，较上季度提高 1.94 个百分点。

In the first three quarters, the company's operating revenue was 269.024 billion yuan, and net profit attributable to the parent company was 132.040 billion yuan. During the same period, R&D investment was 11.071 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 73.03%; DRAM products developed based on the sixth-generation technology platform have completed engineering sample verification. 前三季度，公司营业收入为 2690.24 亿元，归母净利润为 1320.40 亿元。同期研发投入 110.71 亿元，同比增长 73.03%；基于第六代技术平台开发的 DRAM 产品已完成工程样片验证。

item.title: 联发科第三季度营收增长 18.3%，归母净利润增长 10.6%
item.guid: 联发科第三季度营收增长-18.3%，归母净利润增长-10.6%
item.description:
MediaTek announced its third-quarter results: revenue was NT$168.058 billion, a year-on-year increase of 18.3% and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 10.4%; net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$27.882 billion, a year-on-year increase of 10.6%. 联发科公布第三季度业绩：收入为 1680.58 亿新台币，同比增长 18.3%、环比增长 10.4%；归属母公司净利润为 278.82 亿新台币，同比增长 10.6%。

The company stated that the ramp-up of new Smart Edge projects and the increased DRAM content in TV system chips drove revenue growth. The quarterly gross profit margin was 46.3%, an increase of 0.1 percentage points from the previous quarter and a decrease of 0.2 percentage points from the same period last year. 公司称，Smart Edge 新项目放量，以及电视系统芯片的 DRAM 含量提高，带动了收入增长。季度毛利率为 46.3%，较上季度提高 0.1 个百分点，较上年同期下降 0.2 个百分点。

During the period, R&D expenses were NT$42.237 billion, accounting for 25.1% of revenue. 期内研发费用为 422.37 亿新台币，占收入 25.1%。

item.title: 💡 诺奖得主 Acemoglu：AI 应帮助劳动者，别只盯着 AGI
item.guid: 💡-诺奖得主-Acemoglu：AI-应帮助劳动者，别只盯着-AGI
item.description:
Nobel laureate in economics and MIT professor Daron Acemoglu stated in a recent Bloomberg interview that he had previously underestimated the development speed of agent AI, but using chatbots in personal life and AI entering production processes are still two distinct matters that need to be differentiated. 诺贝尔经济学奖得主、MIT 教授 Daron Acemoglu 在彭博最新专访中表示，他此前低估了智能体 AI 的发展速度，但个人生活中使用聊天机器人，与 AI 进入生产流程，仍是两件需要区分的事。

He opposes setting Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) as the sole direction of development, believing that over-obsession with this goal will prevent other applications from being fully explored. He suggested that if more AI talents could shift towards goals such as improving worker productivity and expanding citizen autonomy, technology would develop in these directions; he also believes that China is more actively trying to integrate AI into production processes than the United States. 他反对把通用人工智能（AGI）设为唯一发展方向，认为过度执着于这一目标，会让其他用途得不到充分探索。他提出，如果更多 AI 人才能转向提高劳动者生产力、扩大公民自主权等目标，技术就会沿这些方向发展；他也认为，中国比美国更积极地尝试把 AI 融入生产流程。

When discussing automation incentives, Acemoglu advocates for narrowing the tax difference between capital income and labor income, reducing additional incentives for companies to replace labor with capital. He also acknowledges that changes in tax burdens may lead to practical concerns such as corporate relocation, and specific policies require negotiation. 谈到自动化激励时，Acemoglu 主张缩小资本收入与劳动收入的税收差别，减少企业以资本替代劳动的额外激励。他同时承认，税负变化可能带来企业外迁等现实顾虑，具体政策需要协商。

Regarding the assertion that "AI will change life, but a few tech entrepreneurs should decide its direction," he believes that the deeper the impact of technology, the greater the public's responsibility to participate in shaping its development. 对于「AI 将改变生活，却应让少数科技企业家决定方向」的主张，他认为，技术的影响越深，公众就越有责任参与塑造其发展。

item.title: 2027 款奕派 007 上市，限时补贴价 10.99 万元起
item.guid: 2027-款奕派-007-上市，限时补贴价-10.99-万元起
item.description:
The 2027 Dongfeng eπ 007 was launched at the Wuhan Auto Show, introducing the "550 Cruise Edition" and "675 Laser Edition," with a limited-time subsidized price starting from 109,900 yuan. 2027 款东风奕派 007 在武汉车展上市，推出「550 巡航版」与「675 激光版」，限时补贴价 10.99 万元起。

The new car adopts a rear-wheel-drive platform, with a length of 4880 mm and a wheelbase of 2915 mm. The 675 Laser Edition is equipped with a 73.5 kWh battery, offering a CLTC pure electric range of 675 kilometers, and features the Tianyuan T200 assisted driving system with lidar. 新车采用后驱平台，车长 4880 毫米、轴距 2915 毫米。675 激光版搭载 73.5 千瓦时电池，CLTC 纯电续航为 675 公里，并配备带激光雷达的天元 T200 辅助驾驶系统。

The cockpit has been upgraded to Tianyuan Smart Cabin 2.0, featuring the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8295P chip. The vehicle also offers a full-temperature zone heat pump, semi-hidden mechanical door handles, and an electric liftgate. 座舱升级为天元智舱 2.0，采用高通骁龙 8295P 芯片。车辆还提供全温域热泵、半隐藏式机械门把手及电动掀背尾门。

item.title: Google Antigravity 上线插件市场，接入 Figma、Jira 与生产日志
item.guid: Google-Antigravity-上线插件市场，接入-Figma、Jira-与生产日志
item.description:
Google has launched a unified plugin marketplace for the Antigravity App and CLI, allowing external service connections, domain operation guides, and automation rules to be packaged and installed. Initial integrations cover work scenarios such as design, project collaboration, cloud services, data analysis, and security. Google 为 Antigravity App 和 CLI 上线统一插件市场，把外部服务连接、领域操作指引及自动化规则打包安装。首发集成覆盖设计、项目协作、云服务、数据分析和安全等工作场景。

Plugins can include Skills, MCP service configurations, rules, Hooks, and custom agents, installed, updated, and started/stopped together with the same version. Interfaces, environment variables, and commands that were previously configured separately can now be shared as a complete component; integrations involving account authorization will require corresponding authentication during setup. 插件可以包含 Skills、MCP 服务配置、规则、Hooks 和自定义智能体，随同一版本一起安装、更新和启停。过去分别配置的接口、环境变量与指令，因而可以作为一个完整组件共享；涉及账号授权的集成会在设置时要求相应认证。

For example, the Figma plugin can read design context and write content to the canvas; Atlassian integration connects work information from Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket; the Datadog plugin can search logs, traces, and alerts to help locate online failures. Users can browse plugins from the App's Customizations panel or install them via CLI. 例如，Figma 插件可读取设计上下文并向画布写入内容；Atlassian 集成连接 Jira、Confluence 和 Bitbucket 等工作信息；Datadog 插件则可搜索日志、链路与告警，辅助定位线上故障。用户可从 App 的 Customizations 面板浏览插件，也可通过 CLI 安装。

item.title: 百度搜索 API 推出活动价：增强版每千次 4.9 元
item.guid: 百度搜索-API-推出活动价：增强版每千次-4.9-元
item.description:
Baidu AI Cloud Search API has launched a limited-time promotion. From October 30th to December 31st, the enhanced version call package is priced at 4.9 yuan per thousand calls; the flagship version is 9.9 yuan per thousand calls, and an invitation code is required for purchase. 百度智能云搜索 API 开启限时活动。10 月 30 日至 12 月 31 日，增强版调用包活动价为每千次 4.9 元；旗舰版为每千次 9.9 元，购买需使用邀请码。

The service can retrieve web pages, images, and videos, returning titles, original links, and content snippets, and provides intelligent summaries for access by agents or knowledge base applications. 服务可检索网页、图片和视频，返回标题、原始链接及内容片段，并提供智能摘要，供智能体或知识库应用接入。

The cumulative purchase limit for the enhanced activity package is 1 million calls. After the purchased call package is used up, billing will automatically be based on the list price of the corresponding product; the validity period of the call package is subject to the product details. 增强版活动包累计购买上限为 100 万次。已购调用包用完后，将自动按对应产品的刊例价计费；调用包有效期以商品详情为准。

item.title: 《哈克小天地》发售，用微缩景观迎接动物居民
item.guid: 《哈克小天地》发售，用微缩景观迎接动物居民
item.description:
Hokko Spaces, developed by Wonderscope Games and published by Team17, is now available on Steam with Simplified Chinese support. It continues the cozy style of Hokko Life, focusing on small-scale sandbox landscaping. Wonderscope Games 开发、Team17 发行的《哈克小天地》（Hokko Spaces）现已在 Steam 发售，支持简体中文。它延续《哈克小镇》的温馨风格，把重点放在小尺度的沙盒造景。

Players can arrange forest corners, picnic areas, and gardens, adjust time, weather, and seasons, and unlock animal residents after completing light objectives. Residents will stroll through the scene, tend to gardens, and interact with placed items. 玩家可以布置林间角落、野餐场地与庭院，调整时间、天气和季节，完成轻量目标后解锁动物居民。居民会在场景中散步、打理花园，并与摆放的物品互动。

Photo mode provides filters, composition, and focus tools, allowing players to save their created miniature spaces as photos. 拍照模式提供滤镜、构图和对焦工具，可将搭好的微缩空间保存成照片。

item.title: 清华等团队让 96 台机器人共享经验，手机包装成功率升至 98.3%
item.guid: 清华等团队让-96-台机器人共享经验，手机包装成功率升至-98.3%
item.description:
Tsinghua University, Zhipu AI, and Wuwenshenqiong proposed a Collective Experience Learning (CEL) solution, allowing robots to summarize their task completion experiences during deployment to improve commonly used strategies. 清华大学、智元机器人及无问芯穹提出群体经验学习（CEL）方案，让机器人将部署中完成任务的经验汇总起来，改进共同使用的策略。

After experts complete initial guidance, the system uses pre-failure scenarios to retrieve similar successful segments from other robots, which are then used for fine-tuning. Subsequent learning no longer requires new expert demonstrations or corrective actions; humans remain responsible for result annotation and environment reset. 在专家完成初始指导后，系统利用失败前的场景，检索其他机器人做成功的相似片段，再用于微调。后续学习不再需要新增专家示范或纠错动作；人类仍负责结果标注及环境复位。

The team tested five tasks: flower arrangement, clothes folding, phone charging, stool assembly, and phone packaging. The phone packaging experiment used 96 robots to collect experience, and an additional 120 evaluations were completed on two identical robot models that did not participate in the collection, with the success rate increasing from 79.2% to 98.3%. 团队在插花、叠衣、手机充电、凳子组装及手机包装五项任务上测试。手机包装实验使用 96 台机器人采集经验，另在两台未参与采集的同型号机器人上完成 120 次评估，成功率由 79.2% 升至 98.3%。

item.title: 智元发布 GO-3 Preview，以统一框架连接推理、预测与动作
item.guid: 智元发布-GO-3-Preview，以统一框架连接推理、预测与动作
item.description:
Zhipu AI unveiled its embodied foundational model, GO-3 Preview, at its Innovation Day on October 29th. It adopts the WRAM framework, connecting reasoning, environmental prediction, and action execution. 智元在 10 月 29 日的创新日发布具身基础模型 GO-3 Preview，采用 WRAM 框架，将推理、环境预测和动作执行连接起来。

The company demonstrated zero-shot and few-shot task capabilities, hoping that robots can predict action outcomes before execution and adapt to environmental changes, rather than just reproducing fixed procedures. Its training roadmap covers pre-training, post-training, and continuous improvement after deployment. 公司展示了零样本和少样本任务能力，希望机器人在执行前预测动作结果，并在环境变化时调整，而非只复现固定流程。其训练路线覆盖预训练、后训练，以及部署后的持续改进。

According to evaluations released by Zhipu AI on-site, GO-3 Preview achieved first place in task success rate and process scores on RoboDojo, and overall scores on RoboTwin and RoboColiseum. 据智元现场公布的评测，GO-3 Preview 在 RoboDojo 的任务成功率和过程评分、RoboTwin 及 RoboColiseum 的综合评分上取得第一名。

item.title: 小米推出 8 亿参数 OCR 模型，打通文档解析、抽取与问答
item.guid: 小米推出-8-亿参数-OCR-模型，打通文档解析、抽取与问答
item.description:
Xiaomi Technology launched its document understanding model, Xiaomi-OCR-0, on October 30th. It uses 800 million parameters to unify document parsing, key information extraction, and visual question answering. The model can convert text, tables, and formulas into Markdown or LaTeX, extract bill and card information by specified fields and output JSON, and also answer questions about chart content. 小米技术 10 月 30 日推出文档理解模型 Xiaomi-OCR-0，用 8 亿参数统一文档解析、关键信息抽取与视觉问答。模型可把正文、表格和公式转成 Markdown、LaTeX，按指定字段提取票据、卡证信息并输出 JSON，也能围绕图表内容回答问题。

In the officially released two-stage document parsing evaluation, the model scored 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, which includes interferences like simulated scans, paper bending, and screen re-photography, ranking first among the models listed on the page; the OmniDocBench v1.6 score was 96.83. 在官方公布的两阶段文档解析评测中，模型在模拟扫描、纸张弯曲、屏幕翻拍等干扰的 Real5-OmniDocBench 上取得 95.24 分，在页面列出的模型比较中排名第一；OmniDocBench v1.6 得分为 96.83。

Xiaomi states that the related technology is being used in scenarios such as Super Xiao Ai's meal pickup code recognition, bill accounting, and schedule creation. Model weights, inference code, browser demo, MCP service, and Agent Skill toolkit are now open, allowing developers to integrate them into their own document processing workflows. 小米称，相关技术正用于超级小爱的取餐码识别、账单记账、日程创建等场景。模型权重、推理代码、浏览器 Demo、MCP 服务和 Agent Skill 工具包已开放，开发者可以接入自己的文档处理流程。

item.title: hololive 推出服装品牌 holoSynQ，首系列围绕 FLOW GLOW 展开
item.guid: hololive-推出服装品牌-holoSynQ，首系列围绕-FLOW-GLOW-展开
item.description:
VTuber company COVER has partnered with Japanese textile trading company MN Inter-Fashion to launch the apparel brand "hololive – holoSynQ." The first collection is themed around their unit FLOW GLOW, integrating character elements into everyday streetwear. VTuber 企业 COVER 与日本纺织商社 MN Inter-Fashion 合作推出服装品牌「hololive – holoSynQ」，首个系列以旗下组合 FLOW GLOW 为主题，将角色元素融入日常街头服饰。

COVER is responsible for brand concept and design direction, while MN Inter-Fashion handles fabrics, garment production, and quality control. The first wave of designs uses neutral sizing, including track jackets, hoodies, and sweatshirts that can be paired with patches; the official website also showcases items like trousers, graphic T-shirts, hats, and bags, with some designs featuring patterns created through embroidery and puff printing. COVER 负责品牌概念与设计方向，MN Inter-Fashion 负责面料、服装制作及品质管理。首波设计使用中性版型，包含运动外套、连帽上衣和可搭配布章的卫衣；官网还展示了长裤、图案 T 恤、帽子和包袋等单品，部分设计通过刺绣和发泡印刷呈现图案。

The brand's official website launched on October 30th. The first wave of products is scheduled to be sold first from November 6th to January 14th, 2027, at a pop-up store on the 4th floor of KIDDY LAND in Tokyu Plaza Omotesando OMOKADO, Tokyo, a location near the hololive Harajuku official store. 品牌官网于 10 月 30 日上线。首波商品计划在 11 月 6 日至 2027 年 1 月 14 日，于东京东急 Plaza 表参道 OMOKADO 的 KIDDY LAND 4 楼快闪店率先销售，地点邻近 hololive 原宿官方商店。

item.title: 日本松屋会员数据遭入侵，涉及逾 237 万条记录
item.guid: 日本松屋会员数据遭入侵，涉及逾-237-万条记录
item.description:
Japanese restaurant chain Matsuya disclosed that its membership system suffered unauthorized access, involving approximately 2.377 million member records, which may include member IDs, names, addresses, phone numbers, and loyalty point information. 日本餐饮连锁松屋披露，会员系统遭未授权访问，涉及约 237.7 万条会员记录，可能包含会员编号、姓名、地址、电话号码及积分信息。

According to the original report by Impress Watch, another approximately 2,000 to potentially 3,000 records also involved birth dates, email addresses, and encrypted passwords. The company stated that the system did not store credit card information. 据 Impress Watch 原始报道，另一部分约 2000 条、最多可能约 3000 条记录还涉及出生日期、电子邮箱和加密密码。公司称，系统没有保存信用卡信息。

Matsuya discovered the anomaly on October 28th, subsequently launched an investigation, reported it to the Personal Information Protection Commission, and plans to contact affected members. 松屋于 10 月 28 日发现异常，随后展开调查，并向个人信息保护委员会报告，计划联系受影响会员。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜合上 iPhone Duo，烤一份虚拟芝士吐司
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜合上-iPhone-Duo，烤一份虚拟芝士吐司
item.description:
Toastie turns a foldable phone into a toaster. First, select bread, then spread butter, cheese, and other toppings. Close the iPhone Duo, and heating begins; when you unfold it again, the toast is ready. Toastie 把折叠手机变成了烤吐司机。先选面包，再铺上黄油、芝士和其他配料，合上 iPhone Duo，就开始加热；重新展开时，吐司也到了出炉时刻。

Opening it too early will result in undercooked toast, while leaving it too long will burn it. The game scores based on recipe, plating, degree of toasting, and preparation time, and the cooking process also includes a realistic waiting rhythm. 开得太早会夹生，放得太久则会烤焦。游戏会结合配方、摆盘、烘烤程度和准备时间评分，制作过程也包含真实等待的节奏。

The app was developed by Tomasz Szykulski. Other iPhones and iPads can operate a virtual toaster lid, while the Duo directly uses the phone's hinge for the closing action. 应用由 Tomasz Szykulski 开发。其他 iPhone 和 iPad 可以操作虚拟烤盘盖，Duo 则将合盖动作直接交给手机铰链。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《艾泽拉斯星球》把鱼人和狗头人拍成自然纪录片
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《艾泽拉斯星球》把鱼人和狗头人拍成自然纪录片
item.description:
British comedian and musician Bill Bailey transforms into a dwarf explorer, venturing into the ecosystems of World of Warcraft. "Planet Azeroth" adopts the narrative style of a nature documentary, turning in-game creatures like murlocs and kobolds into subjects of observation, with Bailey providing voiceovers to introduce their lives. 英国喜剧演员兼音乐人 Bill Bailey 化身矮人探险家，走进《魔兽世界》的生态环境。《艾泽拉斯星球》（Planet Azeroth）借用自然纪录片的讲述方式，把鱼人、狗头人等游戏生物变成观察对象，由 Bailey 配音介绍它们的生活。

The series is planned for three episodes, traversing areas such as Elwynn Forest and Winterspring. The first episode is already available on the official World of Warcraft YouTube channel, lasting 6 minutes and 47 seconds, with murlocs and kobolds listed as main characters in the official description. 系列共计划三集，将穿过艾尔文森林、冬泉谷等地区。首集已上线 World of Warcraft 官方 YouTube 频道，时长 6 分 47 秒，官方简介列出的主角包括鱼人和狗头人。

TechRadar's review described it as a "documentary gone wrong" mockumentary, suggesting it could warm up for "World of Warcraft: Forever" while maintaining a wait-and-see attitude towards the new work. Bailey, in a public introduction, said that he has always been fascinated by the natural world, and this time exploring Azeroth, he finally doesn't have to worry about being bitten or getting his clothes wet. TechRadar 的评论将其描述为一部「纪录片失控」式伪纪录片，并认为它可以为《World of Warcraft: Forever》预热，同时保留对新作的观望。Bailey 则在公开介绍中说，自己一直着迷于自然世界，这次探索艾泽拉斯时终于不用担心被咬或弄湿衣服。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《群鸟》从秋日乡野写到无法解释的恐怖
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《群鸟》从秋日乡野写到无法解释的恐怖
item.description:
Daphne du Maurier's "The Birds" starts in the autumn countryside of Cornwall, England, allowing the familiar natural environment to gradually become a threat. The story was later adapted into a film of the same name by Hitchcock; the original work accumulated fear through realistic details, rather than providing a clear explanation for the birds' behavior. 达芙妮·杜穆里埃的《群鸟》（The Birds）从英国康沃尔的秋日乡野出发，让熟悉的自然环境逐渐变成威胁。这个故事后来被希区柯克改编成同名电影；原著以写实细节累积恐惧，而非为鸟群的行为给出清楚的解释。

The English e-book edition released by Virago, an imprint of Hachette, is available as a free sample, published on August 11, 2025, with ISBN 9780349021096. It is also a sample chapter from du Maurier's short story collection "After Midnight," which features a new introduction by Stephen King. Hachette 旗下 Virago 推出的英文电子版可作为免费试读获取，发行于 2025 年 8 月 11 日，ISBN 为 9780349021096。它也是杜穆里埃短篇合集《After Midnight》的试读篇目，合集配有斯蒂芬·金新写的导言。

A Guardian review included by the publisher suggests that the story gradually moves from an almost idyllic Cornish setting into incomprehensible horror; writer Sarah Waters describes these short stories as tales where nature goes awry, and the boundaries between the ordinary and the eerie blur. 出版社收录的《卫报》评论认为，故事从近乎田园式的康沃尔场景，逐步进入难以理解的恐怖；作家 Sarah Waters 则把这批短篇描述为自然失常、日常与诡异边界模糊的故事。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《无人深空》在星际送快递，也能直接飞向邻近恒星
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《无人深空》在星际送快递，也能直接飞向邻近恒星
item.description:
Hello Games' "No Man's Sky" allows players to explore planets, gather resources, upgrade spacecraft, and build bases in a procedurally generated universe. Each planet has its own landscape and life, and players can travel alone or share discoveries and cooperate on construction with other players. The Steam Simplified Chinese store page currently shows "Overwhelmingly Positive" for both recent reviews and Simplified Chinese reviews. Hello Games 的《无人深空》让玩家在程序生成的宇宙中探索星球、采集资源、升级飞船并建造基地。每颗星球有自己的地貌和生命，玩家可以独自远行，也可以与其他玩家分享发现、合作建设。Steam 简体中文商店页目前的近期评测和简体中文评测均为「特别好评」。

The newly launched Forsaken 7.10 update adds space delivery missions: players with light frigates and gravity coils can pick up package delivery contracts from deep-space outposts. During flight, stars in neighboring systems can also be directly selected and warped to, without needing to open the galaxy map first; strange souvenirs can be collected from abandoned freighters, infected outposts, and deep-space wrecks, which can be exchanged for biomechanical-style ship modules. 新上线的 Forsaken 7.10 更新增加了太空快递任务：拥有轻型护卫舰和引力线圈的玩家，可从深空前哨接取包裹运送委托。飞行途中，邻近星系的恒星也能直接选中并跃迁，无需先打开银河地图；废弃货船、感染前哨与深空残骸中则能收集奇异纪念物，换取生物机械风格的舰船模块。

The full game is now available on iOS, with the interface redesigned for touch control. The official statement says the mobile version has been optimized for battery life and heat management. The PC version was developed and published by Hello Games, with a release date recorded as August 13, 2016, on its Steam page. 完整游戏现已登陆 iOS，界面针对触控重新设计，官方称移动版针对电池续航和发热作了优化。PC 版由 Hello Games 开发并发行，Steam 页面记录的发行日期为 2016 年 8 月 13 日。
